paragraphs.text: Bicycle frames are usually made of steel, aluminium or carbon fibre, but a small number of workshops now build them from bamboo. The idea is not new. Bamboo bicycles were shown at an exhibition in London in 1894, although they were never produced in large numbers at that time.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Modern builders choose bamboo mainly for the way it rides. The hollow stems absorb much of the vibration from rough roads, so riders feel fewer bumps than on a metal frame. A bamboo frame is also surprisingly strong: in laboratory tests, several frames survived the same impact loads as standard steel ones.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: The stems cannot simply be cut and joined, however. They must first be dried slowly for several months, and many builders heat them over a flame to harden the outer layer and protect it from insects. The joints are usually wrapped in hemp fibre soaked in resin, which takes longer than welding metal tubes.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: For this reason a bamboo bicycle is rarely cheap. A frame from a specialist workshop can cost more than a mid-range carbon one. Several community projects in Ghana and the Philippines, however, train local people to build simpler frames from bamboo grown nearby, and sell them at a price that residents can afford.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: Bamboo bicycles were shown at an exhibition in London in 1894
items.prompt: Bamboo bicycles were first made in the 1990s.

explanation.en: “shown at an exhibition in London in 1894” — bamboo bicycles already existed in the 19th century, so they were not first made in the 1990s → FALSE.
explanation.kk: «shown at an exhibition in London in 1894» — бамбук велосипедтер XIX ғасырда-ақ болған, демек олар 1990 жылдары алғаш жасалмаған → FALSE.
explanation.ru: «shown at an exhibition in London in 1894» — бамбуковые велосипеды существовали уже в XIX веке, значит, не впервые в 1990-х → FALSE.

items.quote: The hollow stems absorb much of the vibration from rough roads, so riders feel fewer bumps
items.prompt: Bamboo frames reduce the effect of uneven road surfaces on the rider.

explanation.en: “absorb much of the vibration from rough roads, so riders feel fewer bumps” — “uneven road surfaces” = “rough roads”, “reduce the effect” = “feel fewer bumps”. Same meaning → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «absorb much of the vibration from rough roads, so riders feel fewer bumps»: «uneven road surfaces» = «rough roads», «reduce the effect» = «feel fewer bumps». Мағынасы сәйкес → TRUE.
explanation.ru: «absorb much of the vibration from rough roads, so riders feel fewer bumps» — «uneven road surfaces» = «rough roads», «reduce the effect» = «feel fewer bumps». Смысл совпадает → TRUE.

items.quote: A bamboo frame is also surprisingly strong
items.prompt: Bamboo frames weigh less than carbon fibre frames.

explanation.en: The text says bamboo is strong and compares it with steel for impact loads. It says nothing about weight or about carbon fibre in this respect → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Бамбук берік деп айтылған, оны жүктеме бойынша болатпен салыстырады. Салмағы туралы да, карбонмен салыстыру туралы да мәтінде ештеңе жоқ → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: О бамбуке сказано, что он прочный, и его сравнивают со сталью по нагрузкам. Про вес и про сравнение с карбоном текст ничего не говорит → NOT GIVEN.

items.quote: which takes longer than welding metal tubes
items.prompt: Joining bamboo stems takes less time than welding metal tubes.

explanation.en: “takes longer than welding metal tubes” — joining bamboo takes longer, but the statement says “less time”. A direct contradiction → FALSE.
explanation.kk: «takes longer than welding metal tubes» — бамбукты жалғау дәнекерлеуден ұзаққа созылады, ал тұжырымда «less time» делінген. Тікелей қайшылық → FALSE.
explanation.ru: «takes longer than welding metal tubes» — соединение бамбука дольше сварки, а в утверждении «less time». Прямое противоречие → FALSE.

items.quote: Several community projects in Ghana and the Philippines, however, train local people to build simpler frames
items.prompt: The community projects in Ghana receive money from the government.

explanation.en: The projects train local people and sell frames at an affordable price. Who funds them is not mentioned → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Жобалар жергілікті тұрғындарды оқытып, раманы қолжетімді бағамен сататыны айтылған. Оларды кім қаржыландыратыны айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: О проектах сказано, что они обучают местных жителей и продают рамы по доступной цене. Кто их финансирует, не сказано → NOT GIVEN.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE if the statement agrees with the information, FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, or NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.
